changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.40
- Limiter sessions now have four roles. Host: the creator, full control. Admin: a co-host who can also pulse and manage roles. Member: must opt in (Accept control) to be pulsed. Idiot: force-controlled and locked out of their own toggles. The host or an admin clicks a player in the roster to cycle their role (Member, Admin, Idiot).
- Reconnect reliability: it now fires whichever direction it captured (instead of needing both) and sends the reset twice. (Networks that drop forged RST packets can still block reconnect.)
